summary: Frontend-only test of rewritten /vendor/emd (VendorEmdE.jsx) as testvendor@pmcmanagers.com. Empty state + seeded state (5 TEST bids: 2 due USD/INR, 1 paid, 1 refund pending, 1 refunded) verified. Header shows Test Supplier Co / VEN-TEST01, no Emerald Corporates / USD 61,380. KPIs: Due 'USD 1,000 · INR 50,000' (2 bids), Held 'USD 5,000' (2 deposits), Refund 'USD 3,000' (1 pending) - all correct, per-currency, no conversion. Empty state shows '—' and 0 counts + vemd-deposits-empty. Table rows/pills/detail correct; status and currency filters (incl. combined, empty result) work. Pay EMD (row) -> /api/v1/payments/emd/checkout 200 -> redirected to checkout.stripe.com with correct INR amount. Statement PDF downloads (PMC-EMD-Statement.pdf). Receipt PDF downloads when a paid payment_transaction exists; shows 'Receipt download failed.' toast when none exists. vendor-fee-receipts section present. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, table collapses to stacked cards, buttons usable. All TEST data deleted.
